unsure: PA-bureau: the statute only requires the Bureau toll-free number in the contract; the one sentence is an Attorney General suggestion inside a whole FAQ block, so nothing is loaded.

PA-door: the state file shows two overlapping cancellation rules (HICPA 7(b) on every contract and UTPCPL 7 for sales at the residence); the second needs its statement and form only when sold at the customer's home.
PA-emergency-form: the form is only used when the customer calls about an emergency and waives the right; added for the checklist, unclear whether it belongs in a normal contract.
deposit_cap: the one-third cap applies only above $5,000, so the fraction field was left empty rather than apply it to every job.
cleaning.home_solicitation_applies_to_cleaning: set true because section 7 covers services sold at the residence at $25 or more; the state file does not say this about cleaning in particular.
